Requirements:

Folder Structure: Follow the structure: /repo for code, /docs for existing docs. Organize /repo into layers: internal/api, internal/service, internal/repository, and internal/domain.
Database: Initialize a SQLite database with migrations support. Create the users and sessions tables.
Authentication: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/login using bcrypt for password hashing and Secure/HttpOnly cookies for sessions.
RBAC: Implement a middleware for Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) as described in design.md section 8.
Audit Foundation: Create the audit_events table (append-only) and a basic AuditService to log login successes/failures.
Refer to questions.md #1 and #14 for architectural and security expectations.

<content>1: # Clinic Administration Suite Design
2: 
3: ## 1. Goals and Constraints
4: 
5: - Fully local, offline-first deployment for clinic operations
6: - Reliable behavior on LAN without cloud dependencies
7: - Fast UI interactions using HTMX and server-rendered fragments
8: - Strong auditability for clinical and financial actions
9: - Maintainable module boundaries for long-term extension
10: 
11: ## 2. High-Level Architecture
12: 
13: ### Layers
14: 
15: 1. Presentation layer
16:    - Fiber routes for full pages and HTMX fragment endpoints
17:    - Server-side templates for deterministic rendering and simple client logic
18: 2. Application layer
19:    - Use-case services (Admissions, Scheduling, Finance, CMS, Metrics)
20:    - Validation, business rules, conflict checks, transaction orchestration
21: 3. Domain/data layer
22:    - Repositories over SQLite
23:    - Explicit transaction boundaries and optimistic locking
24: 4. Infrastructure layer
25:    - Local media file store, audit logger, background job runner, diagnostics exporter
26: 
27: ### Service Boundaries
28: 
29: - `AuthService`: login, session, password policy, authorization checks
30: - `AdmissionsService`: bed assignment lifecycle and occupancy rules
31: - `WorkOrderService`: creation/execution/completion
32: - `KPIService`: metric rollups and query APIs
33: - `ExerciseService`: CMS metadata, tags, search index management
34: - `MediaService`: file ingestion, checksum, serving policies
35: - `SchedulingService`: constraints and overlap detection
36: - `PaymentsService`: unified transaction model over local gateway adapters
37: - `SettlementService`: shift close, reconciliation, discrepancy handling
38: - `AuditService`: append-only event recording and retrieval
39: 
40: ## 3. HTMX UI Strategy
41: 
42: - Build page shells for major modules; load dynamic regions as fragments
43: - Keep endpoints coarse enough for business operations, fine enough for targeted refresh
44: - Use HTMX swap patterns for low-latency updates:
45:   - row/card replacement after mutation
46:   - partial table refresh after filter changes
47:   - inline conflict banners on failed optimistic updates
48: - Return compact HTML fragments from `/ui/*` routes and JSON from `/api/v1/*`
49: - Use polling only for truly live panels (for example occupancy board every 10-15s)
50: 
51: ## 4. Data Model Design
52: 
53: ### Core Clinical Tables
54: 
55: - `patients(id, mrn, name, dob, ... )`
56: - `wards(id, name)`
57: - `beds(id, ward_id, bed_code, status, version, updated_at)`
58: - `admissions(id, patient_id, bed_id, admitted_at, discharged_at, status, version)`
59: - `bed_assignment_history(id, admission_id, from_bed_id, to_bed_id, changed_at, actor_id)`
60: 
61: Occupancy is derived as active admissions joined to beds; optional materialized snapshot can be maintained for dashboards.
62: 
63: ### Work and Metrics Tables
64: 
65: - `work_orders(id, service_type, created_at, started_at, completed_at, status, assignee_id, version)`
66: - `kpi_service_rollups(id, bucket_start, bucket_granularity, service_type, total, on_time_15m, execution_rate)`
67: 
68: Use a hybrid strategy:
69: 
70: - Real-time metrics for short windows
71: - Precomputed rollups for day/week/month views
72: 
73: ### CMS and Media Tables
74: 
75: - `exercises(id, title, description, difficulty, body_region, search_text, version)`
76: - `tags(id, tag_type, name)`
77: - `exercise_tags(exercise_id, tag_id)`
78: - `contraindications(id, code, label)`
79: - `exercise_contraindications(exercise_id, contraindication_id)`
80: - `media_assets(id, exercise_id, media_type, path, checksum_sha256, duration_ms, bytes, created_at)`
81: 
82: Use indexes on tag joins and difficulty fields. Add FTS5 virtual table for free-text exercise lookup.
83: 
84: ### Scheduling Tables
85: 
86: - `exam_schedules(id, exam_id, room_id, proctor_id, start_at, end_at, status, version)`
87: - `exam_candidates(schedule_id, candidate_id)`
88: 
89: Conflict checks use interval overlap predicates:
90: 
91: - overlap when `start_at < existing.end_at AND end_at > existing.start_at`
92: 
93: ### Finance and Settlement Tables
94: 
95: - `payments(id, external_ref, method, gateway, amount, currency, status, received_at, shift_id, idempotency_key, version)`
96: - `payment_events(id, payment_id, event_type, payload_json, created_at)`
97: - `settlements(id, shift_id, started_at, finished_at, status, expected_total, actual_total)`
98: - `settlement_items(id, settlement_id, payment_id, result, discrepancy_reason)`
99: 
100: ### Cross-Cutting Tables
101: 
102: - `idempotency_keys(id, actor_id, route_key, key, request_hash, response_code, response_body, expires_at)`
103: - `audit_events(id, occurred_at, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, before_json, after_json, request_id, hash_prev, hash_self)`
104: - `job_runs(id, job_type, started_at, finished_at, status, summary_json)`
105: 
106: ## 5. Local Media Storage Strategy
107: 
108: - File layout: `/data/media/{yy}/{mm}/{media_id}_{variant}.{ext}`
109: - Persist metadata in `media_assets`; file path remains opaque to clients
110: - Validate upload with checksum and size before commit
111: - Support static serving for small assets and range streaming for video/audio
112: - Keep a maintenance job for orphan detection and integrity recheck
113: 
114: ## 6. Client Cache Strategy (Shared Workstations)
115: 
116: - Use local browser storage with app-level LRU index keyed by user + device profile
117: - Hard limits: max 2 GB or 200 items, whichever is hit first
118: - Track `last_accessed_at`, `size_bytes`, and content hash
119: - Evict least recently used entries atomically on insert when over threshold
120: - Invalidate on content-version mismatch from server metadata
121: 
122: ## 7. Concurrency, Integrity, and Safety
123: 
124: ### Idempotency
125: 
126: - Enforce on high-risk writes for 24 hours
127: - Request hash protects against same key with changed payload
128: - Return cached result on retry to prevent duplicates
129: 
130: ### Optimistic Locking
131: 
132: - Include `version` on mutable rows
133: - Update with version predicate and increment on success
134: - On conflict, return latest row snapshot for user merge/retry UX
135: 
136: ### Transactions
137: 
138: - Wrap multi-entity operations in SQLite transactions:
139:   - admission + bed status update
140:   - payment + payment_event write
141:   - settlement batch + item writes
142: 
143: ## 8. Security Design (Offline)
144: 
145: - Passwords: bcrypt with strong work factor and lockout/backoff policy
146: - Sessions: secure, httpOnly cookies with rotation on privilege changes
147: - Field encryption: AES-256-GCM for sensitive columns (for example PII/payment references)
148: - Key management: master key from OS-protected secret store; local rotation plan with key versioning
149: - RBAC: role-scoped route guards and UI feature flags from server permissions
150: 
151: ## 9. Audit Logging and Diagnostics
152: 
153: - Append-only audit table; no updates/deletes in normal operation
154: - Chain events using `hash_prev/hash_self` for tamper-evident sequence
155: - Attach `request_id` to app logs, audit events, and job runs
156: - Diagnostic bundle includes:
157:   - recent structured logs
158:   - schema/migration version
159:   - job history
160:   - system health snapshot
161: 
162: ## 10. Operational Patterns
163: 
164: - Background jobs:
165:   - KPI rollup computation
166:   - settlement scheduler (fixed shift times)
167:   - cache/media maintenance
168:   - diagnostic export generation
169: - Recovery:
170:   - idempotent rerun of failed jobs
171:   - checkpointed batch progress for settlements
172:   - startup consistency checks for critical tables
173: 
174: ## 11. Suggested Implementation Order
175: 
176: 1. Core auth/session + RBAC scaffolding
177: 2. Beds/admissions workflow and occupancy UI fragments
178: 3. Work orders and KPI rollups
179: 4. Exercise CMS + media pipeline
180: 5. Scheduling conflict engine
181: 6. Payments and settlement batches
182: 7. Audit hardening + diagnostics exporter
183: 
184: ## 12. Mapping to Question Set
185: 
186: - Q1: layered modular architecture and service boundaries
187: - Q2: HTMX fragment-first rendering and endpoint split
188: - Q3: bed/admission schema and lifecycle transitions
189: - Q4: KPI model with real-time + precompute hybrid
190: - Q5: tagging model + indexed/FTS search
191: - Q6: local media layout and serving strategy
192: - Q7: shared-workstation LRU cache rules
193: - Q8: scheduling constraints and overlap detection
194: - Q9: unified payment abstraction and validation
195: - Q10: auditable shift settlement workflow
196: - Q11: idempotency key store and conflict handling
197: - Q12: optimistic locking with version checks
198: - Q13: append-only, tamper-evident audit events
199: - Q14: offline auth and encryption controls
200: - Q15: logs, request ids, jobs, and diagnostic export

(End of file - total 200 lines)
</content>

<content>1: # Clinic Administration Suite API Spec
2: 
3: ## Document Control
4: 
5: - Status: Draft
6: - Version: 0.1
7: - Scope: Local network-only deployment (offline-first)
8: - Stack context: Go (Fiber), HTMX, SQLite
9: 
10: ## API Style and Conventions
11: 
12: ### Base Paths
13: 
14: - JSON API: `/api/v1`
15: - HTMX fragment endpoints: `/ui`
16: 
17: ### Transport and Auth
18: 
19: - Protocol: HTTP on local network (HTTPS recommended when LAN certificate is available)
20: - Auth mode: cookie-based session for UI, bearer token optional for machine clients
21: - Session timeout: configurable (default 8 hours idle)
22: 
23: ### Request Headers
24: 
25: - `Idempotency-Key`: required for mutating financial and scheduling operations
26: - `If-Match-Version`: required for optimistic-lock protected updates
27: - `X-Request-ID`: optional client-supplied correlation id; server generates if absent
28: - `HX-Request`: sent by HTMX clients for fragment responses
29: 
30: ### Response Format (JSON)
31: 
32: ```json
33: {
34:   "data": {},
35:   "meta": {
36:     "request_id": "req_01J...",
37:     "timestamp": "2026-03-31T08:15:30Z"
38:   },
39:   "error": null
40: }
41: ```
42: 
43: Error shape:
44: 
45: ```json
46: {
47:   "data": null,
48:   "meta": {
49:     "request_id": "req_01J..."
50:   },
51:   "error": {
52:     "code": "CONFLICT",
53:     "message": "Version mismatch",
54:     "details": {
55:       "resource": "admission",
56:       "id": "adm_01J..."
57:     }
58:   }
59: }
60: ```
61: 
62: ### Common Query Parameters
63: 
64: - `page` (default 1)
65: - `page_size` (default 25, max 200)
66: - `sort` (example: `created_at:desc`)
67: - `from`, `to` for time windows (ISO-8601 UTC)
68: 
69: ## Core Resources
70: 
71: ### 1) Authentication
72: 
73: #### `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
74: 
75: - Purpose: authenticate local user
76: - Request: `{ "username": "...", "password": "..." }`
77: - Response: user profile + session cookie
78: 
79: #### `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`
80: 
81: - Purpose: terminate session
82: 
83: #### `GET /api/v1/auth/me`
84: 
85: - Purpose: current user, role, permissions
86: 
87: #### `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`
88: 
89: - Request: `{ "current_password": "...", "new_password": "..." }`
90: 
91: ### 2) Beds and Admissions
92: 
93: #### `GET /api/v1/beds`
94: 
95: - Filters: `ward_id`, `status` (`available|occupied|cleaning|maintenance`)
96: 
97: #### `POST /api/v1/beds`
98: 
99: - Creates bed metadata
100: 
101: #### `PATCH /api/v1/beds/{bed_id}`
102: 
103: - Optimistic lock via `If-Match-Version`
104: 
105: #### `GET /api/v1/admissions`
106: 
107: - Filters: `status`, `patient_id`, `bed_id`
108: 
109: #### `POST /api/v1/admissions`
110: 
111: - Assigns patient to bed atomically
112: 
113: #### `POST /api/v1/admissions/{admission_id}/transfer`
114: 
115: - Transfers active admission between beds
116: 
117: #### `POST /api/v1/admissions/{admission_id}/discharge`
118: 
119: - Ends active admission and frees bed
120: 
121: #### `GET /ui/occupancy/board`
122: 
123: - Returns HTML fragment for bed board (HTMX)
124: 
125: ### 3) Work Orders and Service KPIs
126: 
127: #### `GET /api/v1/work-orders`
128: 
129: - Filters: `status`, `assigned_to`, `priority`, `service_type`
130: 
131: #### `POST /api/v1/work-orders`
132: 
133: - Creates queued work order
134: 
135: #### `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/start`
136: 
137: - Marks execution start timestamp
138: 
139: #### `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/complete`
140: 
141: - Marks completion and records latency
142: 
143: #### `GET /api/v1/kpis/service-delivery`
144: 
145: - Returns execution rate and <=15-minute timeliness
146: - Params: `from`, `to`, `group_by` (`hour|day|week|service_type`)
147: 
148: #### `POST /api/v1/kpis/recompute`
149: 
150: - Rebuilds KPI aggregates for specified interval (admin)
151: 
152: ### 4) Exercise Library CMS
153: 
154: #### `GET /api/v1/exercises`
155: 
156: - Filters: `q`, `tags`, `difficulty`, `contraindications`, `body_region`
157: 
158: #### `POST /api/v1/exercises`
159: 
160: - Creates exercise record with metadata
161: 
162: #### `PATCH /api/v1/exercises/{exercise_id}`
163: 
164: - Updates metadata and searchable fields
165: 
166: #### `GET /api/v1/exercises/{exercise_id}`
167: 
168: - Returns exercise details and media references
169: 
170: #### `GET /api/v1/tags`
171: 
172: - Lists tags by type (`focus|equipment|contraindication`)
173: 
174: #### `POST /api/v1/exercises/{exercise_id}/tags`
175: 
176: - Bulk attach or detach tags
177: 
178: ### 5) Local Media
179: 
180: #### `POST /api/v1/media`
181: 
182: - Upload metadata registration (chunked upload optional)
183: 
184: #### `GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}`
185: 
186: - Returns metadata, checksum, variants
187: 
188: #### `GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}/stream`
189: 
190: - Streams media with `Range` support
191: 
192: #### `GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}/download`
193: 
194: - Controlled static file response with audit trail
195: 
196: ### 6) Exam Scheduling
197: 
198: #### `GET /api/v1/exam-schedules`
199: 
200: - Filters: `date`, `room_id`, `proctor_id`, `candidate_id`
201: 
202: #### `POST /api/v1/exam-schedules`
203: 
204: - Creates schedule item and runs conflict detection
205: - Idempotency required
206: 
207: #### `POST /api/v1/exam-schedules/{schedule_id}/validate`
208: 
209: - Re-checks constraints and returns conflicts
210: 
211: #### `PATCH /api/v1/exam-schedules/{schedule_id}`
212: 
213: - Reschedules with optimistic lock
214: 
215: #### `GET /api/v1/exam-conflicts`
216: 
217: - Query potential overlaps within a window
218: 
219: ### 7) Financial Transactions and Settlement
220: 
221: #### `GET /api/v1/payments`
222: 
223: - Filters: `status`, `method`, `gateway`, `shift_id`
224: 
225: #### `POST /api/v1/payments`
226: 
227: - Creates payment attempt through unified gateway abstraction
228: - Idempotency required
229: 
230: #### `POST /api/v1/payments/{payment_id}/void`
231: 
232: - Voids eligible payment
233: 
234: #### `POST /api/v1/settlements/run`
235: 
236: - Executes shift settlement batch (scheduled or manual)
237: 
238: #### `GET /api/v1/settlements`
239: 
240: - Lists settlement batches and reconciliation totals
241: 
242: #### `GET /api/v1/settlements/{settlement_id}`
243: 
244: - Detailed settlement report and discrepancies
245: 
246: ### 8) Audit and Observability
247: 
248: #### `GET /api/v1/audit/events`
249: 
250: - Filters: `actor_id`, `action`, `resource_type`, `from`, `to`
251: 
252: #### `GET /api/v1/jobs`
253: 
254: - Background jobs and status (KPI rollups, settlements, exports)
255: 
256: #### `POST /api/v1/diagnostics/export`
257: 
258: - Generates offline diagnostics bundle
259: 
260: #### `GET /api/v1/diagnostics/export/{export_id}`
261: 
262: - Download ready bundle
263: 
264: #### `GET /api/v1/health`
265: 
266: - Local readiness and dependency checks
267: 
268: ## HTMX Endpoint Guidance
269: 
270: - Fragment endpoints return HTML only and avoid full layout rendering
271: - Use narrow resource routes, for example `/ui/beds/{bed_id}/card`
272: - Include ETag or version marker in fragment payload for lightweight refresh checks
273: - Prefer server-side sorting/filtering over client-side heavy logic
274: 
275: ## Idempotency Contract
276: 
277: - Applicable to: payment creation, settlement run, schedule creation, other high-risk writes
278: - Key scope: `actor_id + route + idempotency_key`
279: - TTL: 24 hours
280: - Replay response: exact original status and payload
281: - Conflict case: same key with different payload returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`
282: 
283: ## Optimistic Locking Contract
284: 
285: - Every mutable table includes `version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1`
286: - Clients read `version` and send via `If-Match-Version`
287: - Server updates with predicate `WHERE id = ? AND version = ?`
288: - On zero rows affected, return `409 VERSION_CONFLICT`
289: 
290: ## Standard Error Codes
291: 
292: - `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (401)
293: - `AUTH_FORBIDDEN` (403)
294: - `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422)
295: - `NOT_FOUND` (404)
296: - `VERSION_CONFLICT` (409)
297: - `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` (409)
298: - `SCHEDULING_CONFLICT` (409)
299: - `PAYMENT_GATEWAY_ERROR` (502 mapped to local adapter failure)
300: - `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500)
301: 
302: ## Minimal Audit Events per Endpoint
303: 
304: - Login success/failure
305: - Bed assignment/transfer/discharge
306: - Work-order completion
307: - Payment create/void
308: - Settlement run and reconciliation outcome
309: - Exam schedule create/update/cancel
310: - Admin operations (recompute, diagnostic export)

(End of file - total 310 lines)
</content>

<content>1: 1. 01_system_architecture.md
2: # Question 1: Overall System Architecture
3: 
4: ## Context
5: The system is a fully local, offline-first clinic administration suite using Go (Fiber), HTMX, and SQLite.
6: 
7: ## Question
8: How would you design the overall system architecture to ensure modularity, maintainability, and scalability within a local network-only environment?
9: 
10: ## Expected Focus
11: - Layered architecture (UI, API, DB)
12: - Separation of concerns

+	Permissions []domain.Permission

+
+func RequireAuth(authService *service.AuthService, cookieName string) fiber.Handler {
+	return func(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
+		rawToken := c.Cookies(cookieName)
+		if rawToken == "" {
+			return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusUnauthorized, "AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Authentication required", nil)
+		}
+
+		user, session, err := authService.AuthenticateToken(c.UserContext(), rawToken)
+		if err != nil {
+			if errors.Is(err, service.ErrUnauthenticated) {
+				return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusUnauthorized, "AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Invalid or expired session", nil)
+			}
+			return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusInternalServerError, "INTERNAL_ERROR", "Unable to authenticate session", nil)
+		}
+
+		authContext := &AuthContext{
+			User:        user,
+			Session:     session,
+			Permissions: domain.PermissionsForRole(user.Role),
+		}
+
+		c.Locals(authContextLocalKey, authContext)
+		c.Locals("permissions", authContext.Permissions)
+
+		return c.Next()
+	}
+}
+
+func CurrentAuth(c *fiber.Ctx) (*AuthContext, bool) {
+	v := c.Locals(authContextLocalKey)
+	authContext, ok := v.(*AuthContext)
+	if !ok || authContext == nil {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	return authContext, true
+}

+	}
+}

+type loginRequest struct {
+	Username string `json:"username"`
+	Password string `json:"password"`
+}

+func (h *AuthHandler) Login(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
+	var req loginRequest
+	if err := c.BodyParser(&req); err != nil {
+		return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid request payload", nil)
+	}
+
+	result, err := h.authService.Login(c.UserContext(), service.LoginInput{
+		Username:  req.Username,
+		Password:  req.Password,
+		RequestID: httpx.RequestID(c),
+		IP:        c.IP(),
+		UserAgent: c.Get("User-Agent"),
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		if errors.Is(err, service.ErrInvalidCredentials) {
+			return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusUnauthorized, "AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Invalid username or password", nil)
+		}
+
+		var accountLocked *service.AccountLockedError
+		if errors.As(err, &accountLocked) {
+			return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusForbidden, "AUTH_FORBIDDEN", "Account is temporarily locked", fiber.Map{
+				"locked_until": accountLocked.Until.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"),
+			})
+		}
+
+		return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusInternalServerError, "INTERNAL_ERROR", "Failed to process login", nil)
+	}
+
+	c.Cookie(&fiber.Cookie{
+		Name:     h.config.SessionCookieName,
+		Value:    result.Token,
+		Path:     "/",
+		Expires:  result.ExpiresAt,
+		HTTPOnly: true,
+		Secure:   h.config.CookieSecure,
+		SameSite: "Strict",
+	})
+
+	return httpx.OK(c, fiber.StatusOK, fiber.Map{
+		"user": fiber.Map{
+			"id":       result.User.ID,
+			"username": result.User.Username,
+			"role":     result.User.Role,
+		},
+		"permissions":        result.Permission,
+		"session_expires_at": result.ExpiresAt.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"),
+	})
+}
+
+func (h *AuthHandler) Me(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
+	authContext, ok := middleware.CurrentAuth(c)
+	if !ok {
+		return httpx.Error(c, fiber.StatusUnauthorized, "AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Authentication required", nil)
+	}
+
+	return httpx.OK(c, fiber.StatusOK, fiber.Map{
+		"user": fiber.Map{
+			"id":       authContext.User.ID,
+			"username": authContext.User.Username,
+			"role":     authContext.User.Role,
+		},
+		"permissions": authContext.Permissions,
+	})
+}

+
+This repository initializes the Go/Fiber backend foundation with the layered architecture described in `docs/design.md` and `docs/questions.md`.
+

+
+- `cmd/server`: executable entrypoint
+- `internal/api`: Fiber routes, handlers, middleware
+- `internal/service`: application services and security policies
+- `internal/repository`: repository interfaces, SQLite implementations, migrations
+- `internal/domain`: core entities and RBAC definitions

+- `users`, `sessions`, and append-only `audit_events` tables

+

+```

+

# Clinic Administration Suite (Bootstrap)

This repository initializes the Go/Fiber backend foundation with the layered architecture described in `docs/design.md` and `docs/questions.md`.

## Structure

- `cmd/server`: executable entrypoint
- `internal/api`: Fiber routes, handlers, middleware
- `internal/service`: application services and security policies
- `internal/repository`: repository interfaces, SQLite implementations, migrations
- `internal/domain`: core entities and RBAC definitions

## Implemented Foundations

- SQLite initialization and migration runner
- `users`, `sessions`, and append-only `audit_events` tables
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with bcrypt password verification
- Session cookies configured as `HttpOnly` and `Secure`
- RBAC middleware with role-to-permission mapping
- AuditService login success/failure audit events with hash chain support

## Run

```bash
go run ./cmd/server
```

## Optional Environment Variables

- `APP_ADDR` (default `:8080`)
- `APP_DB_PATH` (default `./data/clinic.db`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` (default `clinic_session`)
- `SESSION_TTL` (default `8h`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE` (default `true`)

Implemented a fresh Go + Fiber backend scaffold under `repo` aligned with the layered architecture in `docs/design.md` (Q1), and added the auth/security foundations expected by `docs/questions.md` #14.

**What I set up**
- Initialized module and app entrypoint in `repo/cmd/server/main.go` with Fiber bootstrapping, SQLite initialization, migration execution, and service wiring.
- Created the required layered structure with domain/repository/service/api packages in `repo/internal/domain`, `repo/internal/repository`, `repo/internal/service`, and `repo/internal/api`.
- Added migration support via embedded SQL migrator in `repo/internal/repository/migrations/migrator.go` and initial migration in `repo/internal/repository/migrations/sql/001_initial.sql`.
- Added SQLite tables `users`, `sessions`, and append-only `audit_events` (with update/delete-blocking triggers) in `repo/internal/repository/migrations/sql/001_initial.sql`.

- Implemented RBAC middleware and role-permission mapping in `repo/internal/api/middleware/rbac_middleware.go` and `repo/internal/domain/rbac.go`, including permissions exposed for server-driven feature flags (`/auth/me` + request locals).
- Added audit foundation with hash-chained audit events and login success/failure logging in `repo/internal/service/audit_service.go`.
- Added security helpers expected by Q14: lockout/backoff logic, password policy validation, token hashing for session storage, and AES-256-GCM field cipher utility in `repo/internal/service/field_cipher.go`.

**API routes included**

- `GET /api/v1/auth/me` (authenticated)

27: }

41: func NewAuthService(users repository.UserRepository, sessions repository.SessionRepository, audit *AuditService, bcryptCost int, sessionTTL time.Duration) *AuthService {
42: 	if bcryptCost < bcrypt.MinCost {
43: 		bcryptCost = bcrypt.DefaultCost
44: 	}
45: 	if sessionTTL <= 0 {
46: 		sessionTTL = 8 * time.Hour
47: 	}

59: 	Username  string
60: 	Password  string
61: 	RequestID string
62: 	IP        string
63: 	UserAgent string
64: }
65: 
66: type LoginResult struct {
67: 	User       *domain.User
68: 	Token      string
69: 	ExpiresAt  time.Time
70: 	Permission []domain.Permission
71: }
72: 
73: func (s *AuthService) Login(ctx context.Context, input LoginInput) (*LoginResult, error) {
74: 	now := time.Now().UTC()
75: 	username := strings.TrimSpace(input.Username)
76: 
77: 	if username == "" || input.Password == "" {
78: 		if err := s.audit.LogLoginFailure(ctx, nil, username, "missing_credentials", input.RequestID, input.IP, input.UserAgent); err != nil {
79: 			return nil, err
80: 		}
81: 		return nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
82: 	}
83: 
84: 	user, err := s.users.GetByUsername(ctx, username)
85: 	if err != nil {
86: 		if errors.Is(err, repository.ErrNotFound) {
87: 			if logErr := s.audit.LogLoginFailure(ctx, nil, username, "invalid_credentials", input.RequestID, input.IP, input.UserAgent); logErr != nil {
88: 				return nil, logErr
89: 			}
90: 			return nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
91: 		}
92: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lookup user: %w", err)
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	if user.LockedUntil != nil && now.Before(*user.LockedUntil) {
96: 		if err := s.audit.LogLoginFailure(ctx, &user.ID, username, "account_locked", input.RequestID, input.IP, input.UserAgent); err != nil {
97: 			return nil, err
98: 		}
99: 		return nil, &AccountLockedError{Until: *user.LockedUntil}
100: 	}
101: 
102: 	if err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(user.PasswordHash), []byte(input.Password)); err != nil {
103: 		failedCount := user.FailedLoginCount + 1
104: 		lockedUntil := calculateLockout(now, failedCount)
105: 
106: 		if updateErr := s.users.RecordFailedLogin(ctx, user.ID, failedCount, lockedUntil); updateErr != nil {
107: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("record failed login: %w", updateErr)
108: 		}
109: 
110: 		reason := "invalid_credentials"
111: 		if lockedUntil != nil {
112: 			reason = "lockout_backoff"
113: 		}
114: 
115: 		if auditErr := s.audit.LogLoginFailure(ctx, &user.ID, username, reason, input.RequestID, input.IP, input.UserAgent); auditErr != nil {
116: 			return nil, auditErr
117: 		}
118: 
119: 		return nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
120: 	}
121: 
122: 	if err := s.users.ResetFailedLogins(ctx, user.ID); err != nil {
123: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reset failed login state: %w", err)
124: 	}
125: 
126: 	rawToken, err := randomToken(32)
127: 	if err != nil {
128: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generate session token: %w", err)
129: 	}
130: 
131: 	expiresAt := now.Add(s.sessionTTL)
132: 	session := &domain.Session{
133: 		UserID:     user.ID,
134: 		TokenHash:  hashToken(rawToken),
135: 		CreatedAt:  now,
136: 		ExpiresAt:  expiresAt,
137: 		LastSeenAt: now,
138: 	}
139: 
140: 	if err := s.sessions.Create(ctx, session); err != nil {
141: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create session: %w", err)
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	if err := s.audit.LogLoginSuccess(ctx, user.ID, user.Username, input.RequestID, input.IP, input.UserAgent); err != nil {
145: 		return nil, err
146: 	}
147: 
148: 	return &LoginResult{
149: 		User:       user,
150: 		Token:      rawToken,
151: 		ExpiresAt:  expiresAt,
152: 		Permission: domain.PermissionsForRole(user.Role),
153: 	}, nil
154: }
155: 
156: func (s *AuthService) AuthenticateToken(ctx context.Context, rawToken string) (*domain.User, *domain.Session, error) {
157: 	rawToken = strings.TrimSpace(rawToken)
158: 	if rawToken == "" {
159: 		return nil, nil, ErrUnauthenticated
160: 	}
161: 
162: 	session, user, err := s.sessions.GetActiveByTokenHash(ctx, hashToken(rawToken), time.Now().UTC())
163: 	if err != nil {
164: 		if errors.Is(err, repository.ErrNotFound) {
165: 			return nil, nil, ErrUnauthenticated
166: 		}
167: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("fetch active session: %w", err)
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	return user, session, nil
171: }
172: 
173: func (s *AuthService) EnsureBootstrapAdmin(ctx context.Context, username, password string) error {
174: 	username = strings.TrimSpace(username)
175: 	if username == "" || password == "" {
176: 		return nil
177: 	}
178: 
179: 	if err := ValidatePasswordPolicy(password); err != nil {
180: 		return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap admin password policy: %w", err)
181: 	}
182: 
183: 	_, err := s.users.GetByUsername(ctx, username)
184: 	if err == nil {
185: 		return nil
186: 	}
187: 	if !errors.Is(err, repository.ErrNotFound) {
188: 		return fmt.Errorf("check bootstrap admin user: %w", err)
189: 	}
190: 
191: 	hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), s.bcryptCost)
192: 	if err != nil {
193: 		return fmt.Errorf("hash bootstrap admin password: %w", err)
194: 	}
195: 
196: 	user := &domain.User{
197: 		Username:     username,
198: 		PasswordHash: string(hash),
199: 		Role:         string(domain.RoleAdmin),
200: 	}
201: 
202: 	if err := s.users.Create(ctx, user); err != nil {
203: 		return fmt.Errorf("create bootstrap admin user: %w", err)
204: 	}
205: 
206: 	return nil
207: }
208: 
209: func calculateLockout(now time.Time, failedCount int) *time.Time {
210: 	if failedCount < 5 {
211: 		return nil
212: 	}
213: 
214: 	backoffSeconds := 30 * (1 << (failedCount - 5))
215: 	if backoffSeconds > 1800 {
216: 		backoffSeconds = 1800
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	lockedUntil := now.Add(time.Duration(backoffSeconds) * time.Second)
220: 	return &lockedUntil
221: }

223: func randomToken(size int) (string, error) {
224: 	b := make([]byte, size)
225: 	if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
226: 		return "", err
227: 	}
228: 	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(b), nil
229: }

232: 	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(raw))
233: 	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
234: }

+func NewPatientRepository(db *sql.DB) *PatientRepository {
+	return &PatientRepository{db: db}
+}

+	const q = `
+SELECT id, mrn, name, dob, created_at, updated_at
+FROM patients
+WHERE id = ?`
+
+	var (
+		patient   domain.Patient
+		dob       sql.NullString
+		createdAt int64
+		updatedAt int64
+	)
+
+	err := runner.QueryRowContext(ctx, q, id).Scan(
+		&patient.ID,
+		&patient.MRN,
+		&patient.Name,
+		&dob,
+		&createdAt,
+		&updatedAt,

+	}

+	patient.UpdatedAt = time.Unix(updatedAt, 0).UTC()
+
+	return &patient, nil
+}
+
+var _ repository.PatientRepository = (*PatientRepository)(nil)
*** End Patch"}

+	query := `
+SELECT b.id, b.ward_id, b.bed_code, b.status, b.version, b.updated_at, b.created_at, w.name
+FROM beds b
+JOIN wards w ON w.id = b.ward_id

+		args = append(args, filter.Status)
+	}

+
+	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, query, args...)

+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list beds: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer rows.Close()
+
+	beds := make([]domain.Bed, 0)
+	for rows.Next() {
+		bed, err := scanBed(rows)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan bed row: %w", err)
+		}
+		beds = append(beds, *bed)
+	}
+
+	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("iterate beds: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return beds, nil
+}

+func (r *BedRepository) ListOccupancy(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.BedOccupancy, error) {
+	const q = `
+SELECT
+    b.id,
+    b.ward_id,
+    w.name,
+    b.bed_code,
+    b.status,
+    b.version,
+    a.id,
+    p.id,
+    p.name
+FROM beds b
+JOIN wards w ON w.id = b.ward_id
+LEFT JOIN admissions a ON a.bed_id = b.id AND a.status = 'active' AND a.discharged_at IS NULL
+LEFT JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id
+ORDER BY w.name ASC, b.bed_code ASC`
+
+	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, q)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list occupancy board: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer rows.Close()
+
+	items := make([]domain.BedOccupancy, 0)
+	for rows.Next() {
+		var (
+			item        domain.BedOccupancy
+			admissionID sql.NullInt64
+			patientID   sql.NullInt64
+			patientName sql.NullString
+		)
+
+		if err := rows.Scan(
+			&item.BedID,
+			&item.WardID,
+			&item.WardName,
+			&item.BedCode,
+			&item.Status,
+			&item.Version,
+			&admissionID,

+		if patientID.Valid {

+		}
+		if patientName.Valid {
+			v := patientName.String
+			item.PatientName = &v
+		}
+
+		items = append(items, item)
+	}
+
+	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("iterate occupancy rows: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return items, nil

+	const q = `

+FROM beds b
+JOIN wards w ON w.id = b.ward_id

+
+	bed, err := scanBed(runner.QueryRowContext(ctx, q, id))

+			return nil, repository.ErrNotFound
+		}
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get bed by id: %w", err)
+	}

+}
+
+func (r *BedRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, bed *domain.Bed) error {
+	now := time.Now().UTC()
+	status := strings.TrimSpace(bed.Status)
+	if status == "" {
+		status = domain.BedStatusAvailable
+	}
+
+	const q = `
+INSERT INTO beds(ward_id, bed_code, status, version, updated_at, created_at)
+VALUES(?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?)`
+
+	result, err := r.db.ExecContext(ctx, q, bed.WardID, strings.TrimSpace(bed.BedCode), status, now.Unix(), now.Unix())
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("create bed: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	id, err := result.LastInsertId()
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("create bed last insert id: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	bed.ID = id
+	bed.Status = status
+	bed.Version = 1
+	bed.CreatedAt = now
+	bed.UpdatedAt = now
+	return nil
+}
+

package api

import (
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/handler"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/httpx"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/middleware"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/config"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/domain"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/service"

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
)

type Dependencies struct {
	Config            config.Config
	AuthService       *service.AuthService
	AdmissionsService *service.AdmissionsService
}

func Register(app *fiber.App, deps Dependencies) {
	app.Use(middleware.RequestID())

	authHandler := handler.NewAuthHandler(deps.AuthService, deps.Config)
	adminHandler := handler.NewAdminHandler()
	bedsHandler := handler.NewBedsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	admissionsHandler := handler.NewAdmissionsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	occupancyHandler := handler.NewOccupancyHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)

	v1 := app.Group("/api/v1")
	v1.Get("/health", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
		return httpx.OK(c, fiber.StatusOK, fiber.Map{"status": "ok"})
	})

	authRoutes := v1.Group("/auth")
	authRoutes.Post("/login", authHandler.Login)

	protected := v1.Group("", middleware.RequireAuth(deps.AuthService, deps.Config.SessionCookieName))
	protected.Get("/auth/me", authHandler.Me)
	protected.Get("/beds", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsRead), bedsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/beds", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsWrite), bedsHandler.Create)
	protected.Patch("/beds/:bed_id", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsWrite), bedsHandler.PatchStatus)

	protected.Get("/admissions", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsRead), admissionsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/admissions", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Create)
	protected.Post("/admissions/:admission_id/transfer", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Transfer)
	protected.Post("/admissions/:admission_id/discharge", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Discharge)

	admin := protected.Group("/admin", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAuditRead))
	admin.Get("/audit/ping", adminHandler.AuditPing)

	ui := app.Group("/ui", middleware.RequireAuth(deps.AuthService, deps.Config.SessionCookieName))
	ui.Get("/occupancy/board", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionOccupancyRead), occupancyHandler.Board)
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"

	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/config"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/repository/migrations"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/repository/sqlite"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/service"

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/recover"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.Load()

	db, err := sqlite.Open(cfg.DBPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("open sqlite: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := migrations.Run(ctx, db); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("run migrations: %v", err)
	}

	userRepo := sqlite.NewUserRepository(db)
	sessionRepo := sqlite.NewSessionRepository(db)
	auditRepo := sqlite.NewAuditRepository(db)
	patientRepo := sqlite.NewPatientRepository(db)
	wardRepo := sqlite.NewWardRepository(db)
	bedRepo := sqlite.NewBedRepository(db)
	admissionRepo := sqlite.NewAdmissionRepository(db)

	auditService := service.NewAuditService(auditRepo)
	authService := service.NewAuthService(userRepo, sessionRepo, auditService, cfg.BcryptCost, cfg.SessionTTL)
	admissionsService := service.NewAdmissionsService(db, patientRepo, wardRepo, bedRepo, admissionRepo)

	if err := authService.EnsureBootstrapAdmin(ctx, cfg.BootstrapAdminUsername, cfg.BootstrapAdminPassword); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("bootstrap admin: %v", err)
	}

	app := fiber.New(fiber.Config{DisableStartupMessage: true})
	app.Use(recover.New())

	api.Register(app, api.Dependencies{
		Config:            cfg,
		AuthService:       authService,
		AdmissionsService: admissionsService,
	})

	log.Printf("listening on %s", cfg.Addr)
	if err := app.Listen(cfg.Addr); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("fiber listen: %v", err)
	}
}

content.text:
Implemented the Beds + Admissions module on top of your existing Fiber foundation, aligned with `docs/design.md` section 4 and section 7.2, plus `docs/api-spec.md` endpoints for beds/admissions and the HTMX occupancy board.

- Added clinical schema migration in `repo/internal/repository/migrations/sql/002_clinical_core.sql` with `patients`, `wards`, `beds`, `admissions`, and `bed_assignment_history`, including status checks, indexes, and version columns for optimistic locking.
- Added domain models/constants in `repo/internal/domain/patient.go`, `repo/internal/domain/ward.go`, `repo/internal/domain/bed.go`, `repo/internal/domain/admission.go`, and `repo/internal/domain/bed_assignment_history.go` so bed/admission statuses and versioned entities are first-class in the domain layer.
- Extended repository contracts in `repo/internal/repository/interfaces.go` and implemented SQLite repositories in:
  - `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/patient_repository.go`
  - `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/ward_repository.go`
  - `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/bed_repository.go`
  - `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/admission_repository.go`
- Implemented transactional business logic in `repo/internal/service/admissions_service.go`:
  - `AssignAdmission` (atomic patient+bed checks, admission create, bed->occupied, history write)
  - `TransferAdmission` (atomic current bed->cleaning, target bed->occupied, admission bed switch, history write)
  - `DischargeAdmission` (atomic admission discharge + bed->cleaning + history write)
  - All three operations are wrapped in SQLite transactions.
- Implemented optimistic locking for bed updates via version predicate (`WHERE id=? AND version=?`) in `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/bed_repository.go` and exposed through service `UpdateBedStatus`; API requires `If-Match-Version` for `PATCH /api/v1/beds/:bed_id`.
- Implemented REST endpoints from spec:
  - `GET /api/v1/beds`, `POST /api/v1/beds`, `PATCH /api/v1/beds/:bed_id`
  - `GET /api/v1/admissions`, `POST /api/v1/admissions`
  - `POST /api/v1/admissions/:admission_id/transfer`
  - `POST /api/v1/admissions/:admission_id/discharge`
  in `repo/internal/api/handler/beds_handler.go`, `repo/internal/api/handler/admissions_handler.go`, and routed in `repo/internal/api/router.go`.
- Added HTMX fragment endpoint `GET /ui/occupancy/board` in `repo/internal/api/handler/occupancy_handler.go`, rendering a ward-grouped bed grid with statuses (`available`, `occupied`, `cleaning`, plus `maintenance` fallback) and occupant info when available.
- Updated RBAC permissions for beds/admissions/occupancy in `repo/internal/domain/rbac.go`, and wired new repositories/service in `repo/cmd/server/main.go`.

Validation run:
- `gofmt -w cmd internal`
- `go build ./...`

Natural next steps:
1. Add seed/admin endpoints for creating `wards` and `patients` so admissions flows are fully operable from API only.
2. Add integration tests for transaction safety and version conflicts (especially concurrent bed/admission updates).

package api

import (
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/handler"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/httpx"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/middleware"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/config"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/domain"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/service"

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
)

type Dependencies struct {
	Config            config.Config
	AuthService       *service.AuthService
	AdmissionsService *service.AdmissionsService
}

func Register(app *fiber.App, deps Dependencies) {
	app.Use(middleware.RequestID())

	authHandler := handler.NewAuthHandler(deps.AuthService, deps.Config)
	adminHandler := handler.NewAdminHandler()
	bedsHandler := handler.NewBedsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	admissionsHandler := handler.NewAdmissionsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	occupancyHandler := handler.NewOccupancyHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)

	v1 := app.Group("/api/v1")
	v1.Get("/health", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
		return httpx.OK(c, fiber.StatusOK, fiber.Map{"status": "ok"})
	})

	authRoutes := v1.Group("/auth")
	authRoutes.Post("/login", authHandler.Login)

	protected := v1.Group("", middleware.RequireAuth(deps.AuthService, deps.Config.SessionCookieName))
	protected.Get("/auth/me", authHandler.Me)
	protected.Get("/beds", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsRead), bedsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/beds", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsWrite), bedsHandler.Create)
	protected.Patch("/beds/:bed_id", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsWrite), bedsHandler.PatchStatus)

	protected.Get("/admissions", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsRead), admissionsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/admissions", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Create)
	protected.Post("/admissions/:admission_id/transfer", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Transfer)
	protected.Post("/admissions/:admission_id/discharge", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Discharge)

	admin := protected.Group("/admin", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAuditRead))
	admin.Get("/audit/ping", adminHandler.AuditPing)

	ui := app.Group("/ui", middleware.RequireAuth(deps.AuthService, deps.Config.SessionCookieName))
	ui.Get("/occupancy/board", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionOccupancyRead), occupancyHandler.Board)
}

Great call ΓÇö I continued with the next logical slice and added seed/manage APIs + tests so Beds/Admissions can be exercised end-to-end.

- Added patient/ward repository capabilities (`list/create`) and extended contracts in `repo/internal/repository/interfaces.go`, implemented in `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/patient_repository.go` and `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/ward_repository.go`.
- Extended `AdmissionsService` with patient/ward operations in `repo/internal/service/admissions_service.go`:
  - `ListWards`, `CreateWard`
  - `ListPatients`, `CreatePatient`
  - keeps the same validation/conflict error model already used by beds/admissions.
- Added new API handlers:
  - `repo/internal/api/handler/wards_handler.go` (`GET/POST /api/v1/wards`)
  - `repo/internal/api/handler/patients_handler.go` (`GET/POST /api/v1/patients`)
- Wired routes + permissions in `repo/internal/api/router.go`, and expanded RBAC permission set in `repo/internal/domain/rbac.go` (`wards.*`, `patients.*` plus existing beds/admissions/occupancy).
- Added integration-style service tests in `repo/internal/service/admissions_service_test.go`:
  - optimistic locking conflict on bed status update (`ErrVersionConflict`)
  - transaction rollback proof for assignment flow when history insert fails (invalid actor FK), verifying no partial bed/admission writes remain.
- Verified everything with `gofmt` + full test run: `go test ./...` passes.

If you want, I can continue by adding:
1. API integration tests (Fiber HTTP-level) for `/api/v1/beds` and `/api/v1/admissions/*`.
2. A small seed command/script to pre-create wards/patients/beds for local demo data.

# Clinic Administration Suite (Bootstrap)

This repository initializes the Go/Fiber backend foundation with the layered architecture described in `docs/design.md` and `docs/questions.md`.

## Structure

- `cmd/server`: executable entrypoint
- `internal/api`: Fiber routes, handlers, middleware
- `internal/service`: application services and security policies
- `internal/repository`: repository interfaces, SQLite implementations, migrations
- `internal/domain`: core entities and RBAC definitions

## Implemented Foundations

- SQLite initialization and migration runner
- `users`, `sessions`, and append-only `audit_events` tables
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with bcrypt password verification
- Session cookies configured as `HttpOnly` and `Secure`
- RBAC middleware with role-to-permission mapping
- AuditService login success/failure audit events with hash chain support

# Clinic Administration Suite (Bootstrap)

This repository initializes the Go/Fiber backend foundation with the layered architecture described in `docs/design.md` and `docs/questions.md`.

## Structure

- `cmd/server`: executable entrypoint
- `internal/api`: Fiber routes, handlers, middleware
- `internal/service`: application services and security policies
- `internal/repository`: repository interfaces, SQLite implementations, migrations
- `internal/domain`: core entities and RBAC definitions

## Implemented Foundations

- SQLite initialization and migration runner
- `users`, `sessions`, and append-only `audit_events` tables
- Clinical core tables: `patients`, `wards`, `beds`, `admissions`, `bed_assignment_history`
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with bcrypt password verification
- Session cookies configured as `HttpOnly` and `Secure`
- RBAC middleware with role-to-permission mapping
- AuditService login success/failure audit events with hash chain support
- AdmissionsService with transactional assignment, transfer, and discharge
- Version-based optimistic locking for bed status updates via `If-Match-Version`
- HTMX occupancy board fragment at `GET /ui/occupancy/board`

## Run

```bash
go run ./cmd/server
```

## Seed Demo Data

```bash
go run ./cmd/seed
```

This seeds default wards, patients, and beds if missing.

## Key Endpoints

- Auth: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `GET /api/v1/auth/me`
- Wards: `GET /api/v1/wards`, `POST /api/v1/wards`

- UI fragment: `GET /ui/occupancy/board`

## Optional Environment Variables

- `APP_ADDR` (default `:8080`)
- `APP_DB_PATH` (default `./data/clinic.db`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` (default `clinic_session`)
- `SESSION_TTL` (default `8h`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE` (default `true`)
- `BCRYPT_COST` (default `12`)
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME` (optional)

- `APP_MASTER_KEY_B64` (optional AES-256-GCM key, for field encryption utilities)

Implemented ΓÇö I continued with both follow-ups: API-level integration tests and a seed command.

- Added end-to-end API integration tests in `repo/internal/api/api_integration_test.go`:
  - `TestBedsPatchVersionConflictEndpoint` verifies optimistic locking over `PATCH /api/v1/beds/:bed_id` and expects `VERSION_CONFLICT` on stale `If-Match-Version`.
  - `TestAdmissionsLifecycleAndOccupancyFragment` covers ward/patient/bed creation, admission assignΓåÆtransferΓåÆdischarge, and validates `/ui/occupancy/board` fragment output.
- Added idempotent demo-data seeder in `repo/cmd/seed/main.go`:
  - Runs migrations, then ensures default wards, patients, and beds exist.
  - Safe to run repeatedly (checks existing records first).
- Extended patient/ward data support end-to-end:
  - Repository contracts updated in `repo/internal/repository/interfaces.go`.
  - SQLite implementations expanded in `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/patient_repository.go` and `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/ward_repository.go`.

  - API handlers in `repo/internal/api/handler/wards_handler.go` and `repo/internal/api/handler/patients_handler.go`.
  - Route wiring in `repo/internal/api/router.go`.

Validation run:
- `gofmt -w cmd internal`
- `go test ./...` (passes, including new integration tests)

If you want, I can continue by adding API tests for auth lockout/backoff and RBAC denial paths (403 cases) next.

Implement the Work Orders and KPI Metrics system.

Requirements:

Work Orders: Create a system to queue, start, and complete work orders. Capture started_at and completed_at to measure latency.
KPI Rollups: Implement a background job using a ticker to compute kpi_service_rollups (execution rate and 15-minute timeliness) every hour.
Hybrid Querying: The GET /api/v1/kpis/service-delivery endpoint should combine real-time data for the current hour with precomputed rollups for historical data.

Refer to questions.md #4 and #15 for metric calculation and diagnostic logic.

package api

import (
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/handler"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/httpx"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api/middleware"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/config"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/domain"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/service"

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
)

type Dependencies struct {
	Config            config.Config
	AuthService       *service.AuthService
	AdmissionsService *service.AdmissionsService
}

func Register(app *fiber.App, deps Dependencies) {
	app.Use(middleware.RequestID())

	authHandler := handler.NewAuthHandler(deps.AuthService, deps.Config)
	adminHandler := handler.NewAdminHandler()
	wardsHandler := handler.NewWardsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	patientsHandler := handler.NewPatientsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	bedsHandler := handler.NewBedsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	admissionsHandler := handler.NewAdmissionsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	occupancyHandler := handler.NewOccupancyHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)

	v1 := app.Group("/api/v1")
	v1.Get("/health", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
		return httpx.OK(c, fiber.StatusOK, fiber.Map{"status": "ok"})
	})

	authRoutes := v1.Group("/auth")
	authRoutes.Post("/login", authHandler.Login)

	protected := v1.Group("", middleware.RequireAuth(deps.AuthService, deps.Config.SessionCookieName))
	protected.Get("/auth/me", authHandler.Me)
	protected.Get("/wards", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWardsRead), wardsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/wards", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWardsWrite), wardsHandler.Create)
	protected.Get("/patients", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionPatientsRead), patientsHandler.List)

type Dependencies struct {
	Config            config.Config
	AuthService       *service.AuthService
	AdmissionsService *service.AdmissionsService
	WorkOrderService  *service.WorkOrderService
	KPIService        *service.KPIService
}

func Register(app *fiber.App, deps Dependencies) {
	app.Use(middleware.RequestID())

	authHandler := handler.NewAuthHandler(deps.AuthService, deps.Config)
	adminHandler := handler.NewAdminHandler()
	wardsHandler := handler.NewWardsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	patientsHandler := handler.NewPatientsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	bedsHandler := handler.NewBedsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	admissionsHandler := handler.NewAdmissionsHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	occupancyHandler := handler.NewOccupancyHandler(deps.AdmissionsService)
	workOrdersHandler := handler.NewWorkOrdersHandler(deps.WorkOrderService)
	kpiHandler := handler.NewKPIHandler(deps.KPIService)

	v1 := app.Group("/api/v1")
	v1.Get("/health", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
		return httpx.OK(c, fiber.StatusOK, fiber.Map{"status": "ok"})
	})

	authRoutes := v1.Group("/auth")
	authRoutes.Post("/login", authHandler.Login)

	protected := v1.Group("", middleware.RequireAuth(deps.AuthService, deps.Config.SessionCookieName))
	protected.Get("/auth/me", authHandler.Me)
	protected.Get("/wards", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWardsRead), wardsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/wards", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWardsWrite), wardsHandler.Create)

	protected.Post("/patients", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionPatientsWrite), patientsHandler.Create)
	protected.Get("/beds", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsRead), bedsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/beds", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsWrite), bedsHandler.Create)
	protected.Patch("/beds/:bed_id", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionBedsWrite), bedsHandler.PatchStatus)

	protected.Get("/admissions", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsRead), admissionsHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/admissions", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Create)
	protected.Post("/admissions/:admission_id/transfer", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Transfer)
	protected.Post("/admissions/:admission_id/discharge", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionAdmissionsWrite), admissionsHandler.Discharge)
	protected.Get("/work-orders", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWorkOrdersRead), workOrdersHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/work-orders", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWorkOrdersWrite), workOrdersHandler.Create)
	protected.Post("/work-orders/:work_order_id/start", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWorkOrdersWrite), workOrdersHandler.Start)

}

package domain

type Role string

const (
	RoleAdmin     Role = "admin"
	RoleFrontDesk Role = "front_desk"
	RoleClinician Role = "clinician"
)

type Permission string

const (
	PermissionAuthLogin       Permission = "auth.login"
	PermissionAuthReadMe      Permission = "auth.me.read"
	PermissionAuditRead       Permission = "audit.read"
	PermissionBedsRead        Permission = "beds.read"
	PermissionBedsWrite       Permission = "beds.write"
	PermissionWardsRead       Permission = "wards.read"
	PermissionWardsWrite      Permission = "wards.write"
	PermissionPatientsRead    Permission = "patients.read"
	PermissionPatientsWrite   Permission = "patients.write"
	PermissionAdmissionsRead  Permission = "admissions.read"
	PermissionAdmissionsWrite Permission = "admissions.write"
	PermissionOccupancyRead   Permission = "occupancy.read"
	PermissionWorkOrdersRead  Permission = "work_orders.read"
	PermissionWorkOrdersWrite Permission = "work_orders.write"
	PermissionKPIRead         Permission = "kpis.read"
)

var rolePermissions = map[Role][]Permission{
	RoleAdmin: {
		PermissionAuthLogin,
		PermissionAuthReadMe,
		PermissionAuditRead,
		PermissionBedsRead,
		PermissionBedsWrite,
		PermissionWardsRead,
		PermissionWardsWrite,
		PermissionPatientsRead,
		PermissionPatientsWrite,
		PermissionAdmissionsRead,
		PermissionAdmissionsWrite,
		PermissionOccupancyRead,
		PermissionWorkOrdersRead,
		PermissionWorkOrdersWrite,
		PermissionKPIRead,
	},
	RoleFrontDesk: {
		PermissionAuthLogin,
		PermissionAuthReadMe,
		PermissionBedsRead,
		PermissionBedsWrite,
		PermissionWardsRead,
		PermissionWardsWrite,
		PermissionPatientsRead,
		PermissionPatientsWrite,
		PermissionAdmissionsRead,
		PermissionAdmissionsWrite,
		PermissionOccupancyRead,
		PermissionWorkOrdersRead,
		PermissionWorkOrdersWrite,
		PermissionKPIRead,
	},
	RoleClinician: {
		PermissionAuthLogin,
		PermissionAuthReadMe,
		PermissionBedsRead,
		PermissionWardsRead,
		PermissionPatientsRead,
		PermissionAdmissionsRead,
		PermissionOccupancyRead,
		PermissionWorkOrdersRead,
		PermissionWorkOrdersWrite,
		PermissionKPIRead,
	},
}

func PermissionsForRole(role string) []Permission {
	permissions, ok := rolePermissions[Role(role)]
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	dup := make([]Permission, len(permissions))
	copy(dup, permissions)
	return dup
}

func HasPermissions(role string, required ...Permission) bool {
	granted := PermissionsForRole(role)
	if len(required) == 0 {
		return true
	}
	if len(granted) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	lookup := make(map[Permission]struct{}, len(granted))
	for _, p := range granted {
		lookup[p] = struct{}{}
	}
	for _, need := range required {
		if _, ok := lookup[need]; !ok {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

	if err := migrations.Run(ctx, db); err != nil {

	}

		AdmissionsService: admissionsService,
		WorkOrderService:  workOrderService,
		KPIService:        kpiService,
	})

	log.Printf("listening on %s", cfg.Addr)
	if err := app.Listen(cfg.Addr); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("fiber listen: %v", err)

**Implemented**

- Added work order queue with start and complete tracking including `started_at` and `completed_at` timestamps.
- Created KPI ticker running hourly for rolling KPI computations, combining realtime data for current hour and precomputed historical data via hybrid queries.
- Integrated observability through completion audit logs and job run entries.
- Background job initializes KPI ticker and computes previous hour on startup.
- Modified audit service and repository to support observability.
- Key files: migrations (`repo/internal/repository/migrations/sql/003_work_orders_kpi.sql`), services (`work_order_service.go`, `kpi_service.go`, `audit_service.go`), handlers (`work_orders_handler.go`, `kpi_handler.go`), routing (`router.go`), server main (`cmd/server/main.go`).

**Validation**
- Added comprehensive tests for KPI and work order services, including `work_order_kpi_service_test.go`.
- Tests run confirmed with `go test` command, validating rollups, job lifecycle, and audit log entries.

**Next**
- Monitor KPI ticker behavior in production.
- Enhance observability logs and error handling.
- Extend hybrid query capabilities for different time granularities (Q4/Q15).
- Potential refactoring of audit repository for scalability.

Implemented the Work Orders + KPI Metrics system end-to-end on top of your current foundation, aligned with Q4 (metrics model) and Q15 (observability/job telemetry).

**What I changed**
- Added schema/migration for work operations + metrics + job telemetry in `repo/internal/repository/migrations/sql/003_work_orders_kpi.sql`:
  - `work_orders` (queued/in_progress/completed, `started_at`, `completed_at`, `priority`, `version`)
  - `kpi_service_rollups` (hourly rollups with `total`, `completed`, `on_time_15m`, `execution_rate`)
  - `job_runs` (job execution observability)
- Added domain models in:
  - `repo/internal/domain/work_order.go`
  - `repo/internal/domain/kpi_service_rollup.go`
  - `repo/internal/domain/job_run.go`
- Extended repository layer and SQLite implementations:
  - interfaces in `repo/internal/repository/interfaces.go`
  - work orders in `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/work_order_repository.go`
  - KPI rollups in `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/kpi_rollup_repository.go`
  - job runs in `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/job_run_repository.go`
  - audit tx support in `repo/internal/repository/sqlite/audit_repository.go` and service support in `repo/internal/service/audit_service.go`
- Implemented business services:
  - work order lifecycle in `repo/internal/service/work_order_service.go` (queue/start/complete, latency computation)
  - KPI rollup + hybrid querying + ticker job in `repo/internal/service/kpi_service.go`
  - job run recorder in `repo/internal/service/job_run_service.go`

**Requirement mapping**
- Work Orders queue/start/complete:
  - API + service capture `started_at` and `completed_at` and compute latency in `repo/internal/service/work_order_service.go`.
- Hourly KPI rollups via ticker:
  - `StartHourlyRollupTicker` computes previous-hour rollups every hour in `repo/internal/service/kpi_service.go`.
- Hybrid KPI querying:
  - `GET /api/v1/kpis/service-delivery` combines precomputed historical hourly rollups with current-hour real-time aggregation from `work_orders` in `repo/internal/service/kpi_service.go`.
- Observability:
  - Every work order completion now writes:
    - structured audit event (`work_order.complete`) via tx-aware audit logging
    - a `job_runs` entry (`work_order_completion`)
  - KPI rollup runs also create `job_runs` entries (`kpi_rollup_hourly`).

**API endpoints added**
- Work Orders:
  - `GET /api/v1/work-orders`
  - `POST /api/v1/work-orders`
  - `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/start`
  - `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/complete`
- KPI:
  - `GET /api/v1/kpis/service-delivery`
- Wired in `repo/internal/api/handler/work_orders_handler.go`, `repo/internal/api/handler/kpi_handler.go`, and `repo/internal/api/router.go`.

**Runtime wiring**
- Services and repos wired in `repo/cmd/server/main.go`.
- KPI ticker started in background at server startup.
- Graceful shutdown signal handler cancels ticker context and shuts down Fiber.

**Validation**
- Ran `gofmt -w cmd internal`
- Ran `go test ./...` successfully (including new tests in `repo/internal/service/work_order_kpi_service_test.go`).

If you want, next I can add a diagnostics endpoint for recent `job_runs` + latest rollup timestamps to make KPI job health visible in one call.

Implement the Exercise Library CMS and Local Media Storage strategy.

Requirements:

CMS Schema: Implement exercises, tags, and join tables for contraindications and body regions.
Search: Implement high-performance search using SQLite FTS5 or indexed tag joins for filtering by difficulty and equipment.
Media Storage: Implement local file ingestion to /data/media with the folder structure defined in design.md section 5. Store metadata and SHA-256 checksums in media_assets.
Streaming: Implement the /api/v1/media/{id}/stream endpoint with support for HTTP Range requests for video content.
LRU Cache: Implement a client-side LRU cache simulation in the UI layer (2GB/200 item limit) as described in design.md section 6.
Refer to questions.md #5, #6, and #7 for CMS, Media, and Caching details.

+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exercises (

+    difficulty TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(difficulty IN ('beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced')),

+    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
+);

+    search_text,
+    content='exercises',
+    content_rowid='id'
+);
+
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS exercises_ai

+    VALUES('delete', old.id, old.title, old.description, old.search_text);
+END;

+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO exercises_fts(exercises_fts, rowid, title, description, search_text)
+    VALUES('delete', old.id, old.title, old.description, old.search_text);
+    INSERT INTO exercises_fts(rowid, title, description, search_text)
+    VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.description, new.search_text);

+INSERT INTO media_assets(exercise_id, media_type, path, checksum_sha256, duration_ms, bytes, variant, created_at)

+	now := time.Now().UTC()

+
+	asset.ID = id
+	return nil

+

+	const q = `
+SELECT id, exercise_id, media_type, path, checksum_sha256, duration_ms, bytes, variant, created_at
+FROM media_assets
+WHERE id = ?`
+
+	item, err := scanMediaAsset(r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, q, id))
+	if err != nil {
+		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {

+		}
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get media asset by id: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return item, nil
+}
+

+	const q = `
+SELECT id, exercise_id, media_type, path, checksum_sha256, duration_ms, bytes, variant, created_at
+FROM media_assets
+WHERE exercise_id = ?
+ORDER BY created_at DESC`
+
+	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, q, exerciseID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list media assets by exercise id: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer rows.Close()
+
+	items := make([]domain.MediaAsset, 0)
+	for rows.Next() {
+		item, err := scanMediaAsset(rows)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan media asset row: %w", err)
+		}
+		items = append(items, *item)
+	}
+
+	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("iterate media asset rows: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return items, nil

+	var (

+		createdAt int64

+

+	}
+

+		v := duration.Int64
+		item.DurationMS = &v
+	}
+	item.CreatedAt = time.Unix(createdAt, 0).UTC()
+
+	return &item, nil
+}
+
+var _ repository.MediaRepository = (*MediaRepository)(nil)

		log.Fatalf("open sqlite: %v", err)

	workOrderService := service.NewWorkOrderService(db, workOrderRepo, auditService, jobRunService)
	kpiService := service.NewKPIService(db, workOrderRepo, kpiRollupRepo, jobRunService)

	runnerCtx, runnerCancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())

	go kpiService.StartHourlyRollupTicker(runnerCtx)

	go func() {
		sigCh := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
		signal.Notify(sigCh, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
		<-sigCh

		_ = app.Shutdown()

}

# Clinic Administration Suite (Bootstrap)

This repository initializes the Go/Fiber backend foundation with the layered architecture described in `docs/design.md` and `docs/questions.md`.

## Structure

- `cmd/server`: executable entrypoint
- `internal/api`: Fiber routes, handlers, middleware
- `internal/service`: application services and security policies
- `internal/repository`: repository interfaces, SQLite implementations, migrations
- `internal/domain`: core entities and RBAC definitions

## Implemented Foundations

- SQLite initialization and migration runner
- `users`, `sessions`, and append-only `audit_events` tables
- Clinical core tables: `patients`, `wards`, `beds`, `admissions`, `bed_assignment_history`
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with bcrypt password verification
- Session cookies configured as `HttpOnly` and `Secure`
- RBAC middleware with role-to-permission mapping
- AuditService login success/failure audit events with hash chain support
- AdmissionsService with transactional assignment, transfer, and discharge
- Version-based optimistic locking for bed status updates via `If-Match-Version`
- HTMX occupancy board fragment at `GET /ui/occupancy/board`
- Work order lifecycle (queue/start/complete) with latency capture
- Hourly KPI rollup background ticker with hybrid real-time + rollup querying
- Job run observability (`job_runs`) for work order completion and KPI rollups

## Run

```bash
go run ./cmd/server
```

## Seed Demo Data

```bash
go run ./cmd/seed
```

This seeds default wards, patients, and beds if missing.

## Key Endpoints

- Auth: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `GET /api/v1/auth/me`
- Wards: `GET /api/v1/wards`, `POST /api/v1/wards`
- Patients: `GET /api/v1/patients`, `POST /api/v1/patients`
- Beds: `GET /api/v1/beds`, `POST /api/v1/beds`, `PATCH /api/v1/beds/{bed_id}`
- Admissions: `GET /api/v1/admissions`, `POST /api/v1/admissions`, `POST /api/v1/admissions/{admission_id}/transfer`, `POST /api/v1/admissions/{admission_id}/discharge`
- Work Orders: `GET /api/v1/work-orders`, `POST /api/v1/work-orders`, `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/start`, `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/complete`
- KPIs: `GET /api/v1/kpis/service-delivery`
- UI fragment: `GET /ui/occupancy/board`

## Optional Environment Variables

- `APP_ADDR` (default `:8080`)
- `APP_DB_PATH` (default `./data/clinic.db`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` (default `clinic_session`)
- `SESSION_TTL` (default `8h`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE` (default `true`)
- `BCRYPT_COST` (default `12`)
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME` (optional)
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` (optional, must satisfy password policy)
- `APP_MASTER_KEY_B64` (optional AES-256-GCM key, for field encryption utilities)

	protected.Post("/work-orders/:work_order_id/complete", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionWorkOrdersWrite), workOrdersHandler.Complete)
	protected.Get("/kpis/service-delivery", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionKPIRead), kpiHandler.ServiceDelivery)
	protected.Get("/exercises", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionExercisesRead), exerciseHandler.List)
	protected.Post("/exercises", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionExercisesWrite), exerciseHandler.Create)
	protected.Patch("/exercises/:exercise_id", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionExercisesWrite), exerciseHandler.Patch)
	protected.Get("/exercises/:exercise_id", middleware.RequirePermissions(domain.PermissionExercisesRead), exerciseHandler.Get)

package main

import (

	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/api"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/config"

	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/repository/sqlite"
	"clinic-admin-suite/internal/service"

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/recover"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.Load()

	db, err := sqlite.Open(cfg.DBPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("open sqlite: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := migrations.Run(ctx, db); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("run migrations: %v", err)
	}

	userRepo := sqlite.NewUserRepository(db)
	sessionRepo := sqlite.NewSessionRepository(db)
	auditRepo := sqlite.NewAuditRepository(db)
	patientRepo := sqlite.NewPatientRepository(db)
	wardRepo := sqlite.NewWardRepository(db)
	bedRepo := sqlite.NewBedRepository(db)

	workOrderRepo := sqlite.NewWorkOrderRepository(db)
	kpiRollupRepo := sqlite.NewKPIRollupRepository(db)
	jobRunRepo := sqlite.NewJobRunRepository(db)
	exerciseRepo := sqlite.NewExerciseRepository(db)
	mediaRepo := sqlite.NewMediaRepository(db)

	auditService := service.NewAuditService(auditRepo)
	jobRunService := service.NewJobRunService(jobRunRepo)
	authService := service.NewAuthService(userRepo, sessionRepo, auditService, cfg.BcryptCost, cfg.SessionTTL)
	admissionsService := service.NewAdmissionsService(db, patientRepo, wardRepo, bedRepo, admissionRepo)
	workOrderService := service.NewWorkOrderService(db, workOrderRepo, auditService, jobRunService)
	kpiService := service.NewKPIService(db, workOrderRepo, kpiRollupRepo, jobRunService)
	exerciseService := service.NewExerciseService(db, exerciseRepo, mediaRepo)
	mediaService := service.NewMediaService(cfg.MediaRoot, exerciseRepo, mediaRepo)

	if err := authService.EnsureBootstrapAdmin(ctx, cfg.BootstrapAdminUsername, cfg.BootstrapAdminPassword); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("bootstrap admin: %v", err)
	}

	app := fiber.New(fiber.Config{DisableStartupMessage: true})
	app.Use(recover.New())

	runnerCtx, runnerCancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer runnerCancel()

	go kpiService.StartHourlyRollupTicker(runnerCtx)

	go func() {
		sigCh := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
		signal.Notify(sigCh, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
		<-sigCh
		runnerCancel()
		_ = app.Shutdown()
	}()

	api.Register(app, api.Dependencies{
		Config:            cfg,
		AuthService:       authService,
		AdmissionsService: admissionsService,
		WorkOrderService:  workOrderService,

		MediaService:      mediaService,
	})

	log.Printf("listening on %s", cfg.Addr)
	if err := app.Listen(cfg.Addr); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("fiber listen: %v", err)
	}
}

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/recover"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.Load()

	db, err := sqlite.Open(cfg.DBPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("open sqlite: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := migrations.Run(ctx, db); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("run migrations: %v", err)
	}

	userRepo := sqlite.NewUserRepository(db)
	sessionRepo := sqlite.NewSessionRepository(db)
	auditRepo := sqlite.NewAuditRepository(db)
	patientRepo := sqlite.NewPatientRepository(db)
	wardRepo := sqlite.NewWardRepository(db)
	bedRepo := sqlite.NewBedRepository(db)
	admissionRepo := sqlite.NewAdmissionRepository(db)
	workOrderRepo := sqlite.NewWorkOrderRepository(db)
	kpiRollupRepo := sqlite.NewKPIRollupRepository(db)
	jobRunRepo := sqlite.NewJobRunRepository(db)
	exerciseRepo := sqlite.NewExerciseRepository(db)
	mediaRepo := sqlite.NewMediaRepository(db)
	examScheduleRepo := sqlite.NewExamScheduleRepository(db)
	idempotencyRepo := sqlite.NewIdempotencyRepository(db)

	auditService := service.NewAuditService(auditRepo)

	mediaService := service.NewMediaService(cfg.MediaRoot, exerciseRepo, mediaRepo)
	schedulingService := service.NewSchedulingService(db, examScheduleRepo, idempotencyRepo, auditService)

# Clinic Administration Suite (Bootstrap)

This repository initializes the Go/Fiber backend foundation with the layered architecture described in `docs/design.md` and `docs/questions.md`.

## Structure

- `cmd/server`: executable entrypoint
- `internal/api`: Fiber routes, handlers, middleware
- `internal/service`: application services and security policies
- `internal/repository`: repository interfaces, SQLite implementations, migrations
- `internal/domain`: core entities and RBAC definitions

## Implemented Foundations

- SQLite initialization and migration runner
- `users`, `sessions`, and append-only `audit_events` tables
- Clinical core tables: `patients`, `wards`, `beds`, `admissions`, `bed_assignment_history`
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with bcrypt password verification
- Session cookies configured as `HttpOnly` and `Secure`
- RBAC middleware with role-to-permission mapping
- AuditService login success/failure audit events with hash chain support
- AdmissionsService with transactional assignment, transfer, and discharge
- Version-based optimistic locking for bed status updates via `If-Match-Version`
- HTMX occupancy board fragment at `GET /ui/occupancy/board`
- Work order lifecycle (queue/start/complete) with latency capture
- Hourly KPI rollup background ticker with hybrid real-time + rollup querying
- Job run observability (`job_runs`) for work order completion and KPI rollups
- Exercise Library CMS with tags, body-region/contraindication joins, and FTS5-backed search
- Local media ingestion under `/data/media/{yy}/{mm}/{media_id}_{variant}.{ext}` with checksum metadata
- Media streaming endpoint with HTTP Range support and UI LRU cache simulator

## Run

```bash
go run ./cmd/server
```

## Seed Demo Data

```bash
go run ./cmd/seed
```

This seeds default wards, patients, and beds if missing.

## Key Endpoints

- Auth: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `GET /api/v1/auth/me`
- Wards: `GET /api/v1/wards`, `POST /api/v1/wards`
- Patients: `GET /api/v1/patients`, `POST /api/v1/patients`
- Beds: `GET /api/v1/beds`, `POST /api/v1/beds`, `PATCH /api/v1/beds/{bed_id}`
- Admissions: `GET /api/v1/admissions`, `POST /api/v1/admissions`, `POST /api/v1/admissions/{admission_id}/transfer`, `POST /api/v1/admissions/{admission_id}/discharge`
- Work Orders: `GET /api/v1/work-orders`, `POST /api/v1/work-orders`, `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/start`, `POST /api/v1/work-orders/{work_order_id}/complete`
- KPIs: `GET /api/v1/kpis/service-delivery`
- Exercises: `GET /api/v1/exercises`, `POST /api/v1/exercises`, `PATCH /api/v1/exercises/{exercise_id}`, `GET /api/v1/exercises/{exercise_id}`
- Tags: `GET /api/v1/tags`, `POST /api/v1/exercises/{exercise_id}/tags`
- Media: `POST /api/v1/media`, `GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}`, `GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}/stream`
- UI fragment: `GET /ui/occupancy/board`
- UI cache simulator: `GET /ui/cache/lru`

## Optional Environment Variables

- `APP_ADDR` (default `:8080`)
- `APP_DB_PATH` (default `./data/clinic.db`)
- `APP_MEDIA_ROOT` (default `./data/media`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` (default `clinic_session`)
- `SESSION_TTL` (default `8h`)
- `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE` (default `true`)
- `BCRYPT_COST` (default `12`)
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME` (optional)
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` (optional, must satisfy password policy)
- `APP_MASTER_KEY_B64` (optional AES-256-GCM key, for field encryption utilities)
